item_short_desc: Griffin’s Military Shine Shoe Polish is specially formulated to create a long-lasting shine for your tactical and military footwear. With a blend of pure carnauba wax, bees wax, and the finest grade of waxes and oils, this leather shoe polish provides exceptional stain and scuff coverage for the ultimate protection. The black shoe polish cleans, preserves, waterproofs, and ultimately restores a more vibrant and rich color to military boots, oxfords, and shoes. Proudly crafted in the United States for superior quality and durability.
